title: Phone Booking Fee Tariff and Standing Fees — Crestline Companion Certificates and Passes
content:
**Clause.** Under Crestline Companion Certificates and Passes, the phone booking fee of a call-center booking is the product's phone booking fee — the fee per companion trip booked through the reservations call center, as published for the product.

## Raw fee

The raw phone booking fee is the fee multiplied by one plus the raise percentage, then by one minus the waiver percentage, less the card phone credit, never below zero, rounded half up to the cent.

## Standing fees and the fee charged

- **Phone booking fees still standing** on the certificate or pass are all phone booking fee charges on its ledger less all phone booking fee refunds on its ledger, never below zero, rounded half up to the cent. A fee still standing from an earlier booking covers the new fee up to its own amount.
- **Phone booking fee charged** — the raw phone booking fee less the part of it covered by the phone booking fees still standing on the certificate or pass, never below zero, rounded half up to the cent; a fee covered in full is still recorded, at zero.

## Worked figures (hypothetical inputs, product's phone booking fee 25.00 USD)

| Phone booking fee charges on the ledger | Phone booking fee refunds on the ledger | Standing | Raw fee | Covered | Fee charged |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| none | none | 0.00 | 25.00 | 0.00 | 25.00 |
| 25.00 | 25.00 | 0.00 | 25.00 | 0.00 | 25.00 |
| 25.00 | 15.00 | 10.00 | 25.00 | 10.00 | 15.00 |
| 25.00 and 25.00 | none | 50.00 | 25.00 | 25.00 | 0.00, recorded at zero |

**Rounding.** Every rounding in this rule is half up to the cent, a value lying exactly on a half cent going up to the next cent.
